items.title: Jim Robinson Interview, 1961-06-15
items.q: I tell you my trouble players are like I selected you Harrison Bones yank Buddy Johnson big gas... I got with Harrison Bones, Yank and all them fellas, Buddy Johnson, Eddie Vincent and all them fellas, fast fellas, you see?

ctx.x: everybody when you came out of the army who were the good trombone players in town that you used to listen to like to hear him play

I tell you my trouble players are like I selected you Harrison Bones yank Buddy Johnson big gas Sonny Henry I'm talking about trucking up with trombones Honest Kelly all of them is good trombone all of them is good trombone but when I come to the service I couldn't say that I couldn't do that much much much more I had to learn you see but then for us and for us old trombone players take the George field and take like a edit Vincent all of them was good trombone players big gasp
did any of them have a style like yours at all

items.title: Jim Robinson Interview, 1961-07-13
items.q: I used to mind all the trombone playing that. stuff with Buddy Johnson, Harrison Bone, Vic Gaskett, man they had some good trombone players, yeah.

ctx.x: And that had a front porch, huh?

Yeah, it had a front porch. Sure. Yeah. And I always used to blow some trombone on that porch, man. I wasn't playing trombone then. I used to mind all the trombone playing that. stuff with Buddy Johnson, Harrison Bone, Vic Gaskett, man they had some good trombone players, yeah. They were good trombone players. Who played clarinet with Ori and Oliver? The time that Giza played there I think, who was playing with Oliver? I think it was Johnny Dodds, I think. I think it was Johnny Dodds, yeah.
